intro: Penetration tester (CRTO, CPTS), CPTC team captain at UTSA, and a former CrowdStrike Falcon Complete intern. I write about security research, Hack The Box machines and competitions, and document the things I build.
bio: CRTO and CPTS certified penetration tester and former CrowdStrike Falcon Complete intern. Web and Active Directory pentesting, reporting, and Python/Node.js automation. Open-source contributor to Sliver and bloodyAD. CPTC team captain.

bullets: Designed, built and maintained an AI ticket assistant in Python/Node.js; integrated SOC feedback to guide SOP-based responses and actions, reducing response time by an estimated 50%.
Contributed enhancements to an AI-assisted threat-response tool correlating TTPs, IOCs and telemetry from reviewed detections to support human-reviewed threat-actor attribution.
Handled customer messages and administration tickets in the Falcon Complete Messaging Portal.
Assessed web applications across VPS/SQL and Vercel/Next.js environments; identified an IDOR exposing other users' content and configuration-related disclosure of names and emails.
Delivered technical reports and executive summaries documenting findings and demonstrated impact.
Surveyed commercial sites, deployed cellular extenders, and installed CAT5e, fiber, phone lines and network hardware for enterprise clients.
Troubleshot 30+ daily hardware, software, network and account-security issues; escalated complex cases to specialist teams.
Executed internal phishing simulations and monitored security events with Splunk Enterprise/SOAR; configured firewalls, filtering and IPS/IDS controls.
